Callout.Name: Stolen Pedal Cycle
Callout.Message: Bicycle stolen from outside a shop minutes ago.
Callout.Advisory: Suspect rode off towards the park, description given.

Script.Line: I left it outside for two minutes and it was gone.
Green frame, white seat. That is distinctive.
There is a camera on the shop front. It should have all of it.

Lines.Approach: They rode off on it towards the park five minutes ago. They will not have gone far.
Lines.SignOff: Show me 10-8 when you are clear.
